summary: Opus review of F2 (904-line diff, origin/main...HEAD): 1 Important (deadline verify ignored a stop) fixed via deadline_verify, which also skips the verify in a usage-limit window; selfMatch parsing fixed; paused-deadline check added; verify() once mode simplified; routes/live paths under system roots documented. Tests 371 → 375.
verified_how: check.sh: 375/375 green in 742 s. Red before the fix on a scratch run of run 9e (4/6) and of the step-lint section (8/9); green after. Checks: 'a stop at the deadline comes first: no verify, M1 left for a continue', 'a usage-limit window at the deadline: no verify session to be refused, M1 left for a continue', 'lint: self-match ends the command at a closing backtick or a glued |, and reads --regexp=' (each red before), and 'a deadline while paused verifies a complete milestone once too' (green from the start: coverage). bash -n on lib/*.sh bin/* tests/*.sh and node --check on lib/*.mjs pass. Lint of this run's list: 'lint: 6 findings (no-anchor: 3, outside-repo: 2, self-match: 1); the list is not edited — first: F1-01 step 2 outside-repo' (F1-01 s2, F1-03 s3, F1-06 s2, F2-02 s2 x2, F2-06 s2).

dead_ends.tried: git diff main...HEAD as the step says
dead_ends.why: the local main ref is behind origin/main (F1 merged there), so it repeated F1's diff; reviewed origin/main...HEAD (F2 alone) and wrote that to F2-review.diff

discoveries.text: At the deadline the driver now calls deadline_verify: no verify (and a note '…; stopped by Michael, so no verify before the end' or '…; the usage limit holds until HH:MM, so no verify before the end') when STOP/status: stop or LIMIT_UNTIL holds; else verify_ready once. The end reason stays 'deadline'.
tests/run.sh run 9e's dl() takes DL_BEFORE=<command> (run between the segments) and DL_UNTIL=<s>; dl_status <run> <status> commits INBOX.md's first line in the run's worktree.

outside-repo still trips routes and live paths under /home /root /srv /etc /var /opt /usr /mnt /media (GET /media/x, /srv/n8n/live.lock); the initializer prompt now lets a step that is right as written stay.

questions: Should a stop reached together with the deadline end the run as 'stopped by Michael: <why>' rather than 'deadline'? Kept 'deadline' (the order before F2).
